title: Nvidia Hits $100B Revenue Milestone — But AI Expansion Hits a Funding Speed Bump
author: Kira1Cloud
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/jfaldl75di2i1.png

Fresh off Jensen Huang’s departure, Nvidia just crossed that huge $100B revenue mark, pushing up its long-term growth outlook. But the latest earnings call is signaling way tighter checks on new investments, contracts, and financial backing. The AI hype isn’t fading, but suddenly the market’s getting way more cautious about who can actually fund that massive new compute capacity everyone’s chasing. Interesting shift after all that unbridled bull run, [right?](https://www.moomoo.com/news/post/1005019770?global_content=%7B"promote_content":"11067213","promote_id":20795,"promote_type":43,"sub_promote_id":1%7D)
